image_manifest.description: An asset manifest for a stylized 3D rendered scene of three racing dinosaurs and a referee at a desert starting line.

assets.name: Header Text
assets.description: Red, stylized, irregular 3D block text reading 'RACING DINOSAURS!' located at the top of the image.

assets.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex Character
assets.description: A light-brown, bipedal, stylized T-Rex with its mouth open in an eager, competitive expression, positioned on the left side of the starting line.

assets.name: Brachiosaurus Character
assets.description: A blue, long-necked, stylized Brachiosaurus, smiling gently and standing behind and between the T-Rex and the Stegosaurus.

assets.name: Stegosaurus Character
assets.description: A green, stylized Stegosaurus with distinct orange-brown back plates, standing in the foreground center-right on the starting line.

assets.name: Humanoid Theropod Referee Character
assets.description: A small, upright, bipedal dinosaur-like creature on the far right, wearing a black and white striped referee shirt, a hat, and tan shorts.

assets.name: Checkered Flag Item
assets.description: A black and white checkered finish/start flag on a pole, held high by the humanoid theropod referee.

assets.name: Desert Starting Line Environment
assets.description: The red desert sand ground with white painted start lines and a dust kick-up effect near the racers.

assets.name: Desert Mesa Background Environment
assets.description: Distant reddish rock formations and desert mesas under a light-blue sky with sparse white clouds.

assets.name: Bottom Right Watermark
assets.description: A small, translucent lens-flare type logo/watermark located in the bottom-right corner.
